main.description: A place to eat, as an author names it. An object, not a record: it is embedded in an at.eaten.visit. Two places are the same place when they share a gersId; names and addresses are for people.

name.description: The place's name, normally as Overture has it, editable by the author.

address.description: A one-line street address, normally as Overture has it, for display and for a map link.

price.description: Price band, 1 (cheapest) to 4, conventionally shown as that many currency signs.

gersId.description: The place's Overture Maps GERS id, exactly as Overture issues it. Two places with the same gersId are the same place.

latE6.description: Latitude in microdegrees (degrees × 1 000 000), as Overture gives it.

lonE6.description: Longitude in microdegrees (degrees × 1 000 000), as Overture gives it.

urls.description: Places to read more, in the author's preferred order.

service.description: What this URL is. officialSite is the place's own website; any other link carries no service and is labelled by its label or its host. Consumers dispatch on an exact match against knownValues. Values outside knownValues belong to the authoring client's own vocabulary and MUST be preserved on rewrite and rendered as a plain link.
